title: More shifts, less effort
hook: Can total labor supply rise while effort per shift falls?

knows: basic arithmetic and reading a small table
doesNotKnow: Separate the extensive margin of taking shifts from within-shift effort.

misconception: The quantities in this case can be combined without checking their reference, denominator, or information boundary.
objective: Separate the extensive margin of taking shifts from within-shift effort.
keyState: Both complete computed cases are visible as retained observations; the question-case picture survives Reset.

claims.text: A toy courier works six shifts at nine output units each, compared with five shifts at ten. What is the new total output? Toy inputs A=[6, 9]; B=[5, 10].
claims.source: Local explicit hypothetical assumptions in spec.ts and model.ts; not participant measurements.

claims.text: Computed results: [[54, 6, 9], [50, 5, 10]]. Labels: Total output, Shifts, Output/shift.
claims.source: compute() in the lesson-local model.ts; finite numeric operations over the explicit inputs.

claims.text: More shifts and less effort per shift can coexist with higher total output. The multiplication separates the extensive and intensive margins. A single total would conceal those opposing changes.
claims.source: The two controlled cases in spec.ts; scope limited to these toy inputs and displayed model rule.

claims.text: A new toy case uses Shifts=5, Output/shift=10. What is Total output? Answer: 50.
claims.source: compute() applied to the contrasting new input case; source list is an idea pointer only.

recall.question: A new toy case uses Shifts=5, Output/shift=10. What is Total output?
recall.why: Applying the stated toy rule to the new inputs gives 50. The result depends on these assumptions; it is not a universal behavioral response.

sourceProvenance.text: Zurich bike messengers worked more shifts when pay rose but put in less effort per shift (Fehr & Goette, 2007).
sourceProvenance.caveat: Original list says figures are approximate and papers were not individually rechecked. No empirical source is verified by this build.

meaningfulDifference: Separate the extensive margin of taking shifts from within-shift effort.
